meaning: Who maintains a supplier's bank account does not pay to it; per document: a payment to an account whose latest change the person wrote or approved.
Who orders does not confirm receipt; per document: a goods receipt referencing lines of an order the person wrote or approved.
Who books a supplier invoice does not pay it; per document: a payment settling an item of an invoice the person posted or approved.
Who maintains prices does not approve sales; below cost stays a policy condition (ADR-0043 rule 3).
Who creates or changes partners does not book supplier invoices.
Who administers access does not post journal entries, payments or supplier invoices.
